motor.name: Scorpion SII-4020-540KV
motor.fit_note: V = rpm/Kv + I*R: fit to two Scorpion 12x8E loaded points. The chart does not define voltage measurement point or phase/DC resistance convention; fitted parameters are a conditional effective surrogate, not winding characterization. Unknown ESC/wiring losses bias this motor-only representation. I0 is the sample's 20 V no-load value, held constant by the simulator.

propeller.name: APC LP12080E 12x8E Thin Electric
propeller.map_note: APC v2022-0915, simulation dated 2022-09-22; computational prediction, not wind-tunnel data. Selected rows of its 10000 rpm table; independent from the motor's static fit.
